blocks.text: There are fourteen board variants. Matching the board number is necessary when a recipe asks for a particular variant, and a state requirement can add another condition. The recipe panel labels analysed and analysed AND stable requirements separately.

An ordinary clean board needs analysis before it can satisfy an analysed requirement. A stable board also needs the analysed flag when a recipe requires both. Fabrication and Locator stabilization have different acceptance rules; do not infer one from the other.

A Calculator Plug activates when it holds a stable board. The Locator counts those plugs. Its owner-presence requirement and instability behavior are described in the Locator chapter, not in the recipe browser.
